comments.text:
Extract the MIDI bridge abstraction from the current web-only IntegraService into a platform-agnostic Rust trait in integral-core.

PURPOSE: The VST plugin needs the same request/response, drain loop, and DT1 listener patterns as the web app, but using nih-plug's MIDI I/O instead of Web MIDI API. A shared trait lets both platforms implement the same interface.

DESIGN:
Define a trait in crates/integral-core/src/midi_bridge.rs:

trait MidiBridge {
    fn send_sysex(&mut self, data: &[u8]);
    fn on_sysex_received(&mut self, data: &[u8]);
}

Move the drain-loop logic (currently in web/src/integra.ts drainRust() and the 5ms setInterval) into a Rust-side DrainController that works with any MidiBridge implementor.

Move the RQ1 request/response pairing logic (currently IntegraService.requestData() with 2-second timeout matching by address key) into Rust. This is ~100 lines of TypeScript that should be platform-agnostic.

EXISTING CODE:
- web/src/integra.ts lines 400-530: requestData(), requestToneName(), requestPartMixerState() etc.
- web/src/integra.ts lines 30-50: drainRust() loop
- crates/integral-core/src/device.rs: DeviceState.drain(), DeviceState.send_raw()

OUTPUT: A trait + default implementation in integral-core. The web app's integra.ts can be simplified to call the Rust-side request logic via WASM. The VST plugin implements the trait with nih-plug's SysEx send.

title: Core: extract IntegraService trait for platform-agnostic MIDI bridge
